scope: Actual isolated Docker runc on the existing Linux preparation host; no production API changes, no downloads during tasks, not a container escape proof.

checks.name: Scala typed collection sum
checks.code: object Main { def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = println((1 to 10).sum) }

checks.name: Scala case class and pattern matching
checks.code: object Main { sealed trait Shape; case class Rectangle(w: Int,h: Int) extends Shape; def area(s: Shape): Int = s match { case Rectangle(w,h) => w*h }; def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = println(area(Rectangle(3,4))) }

checks.name: Scala multiline UTF-8 stdin
checks.code: object Main { def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = (1 to 2).foreach(_ => println("[" + scala.io.StdIn.readLine() + "]")) }

checks.name: Scala type error prevents execution
checks.code: object Main { def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = { println("MUST_NOT_RUN"); val n: Int = "wrong"; println(n) } }

checks.name: Scala unhandled exception fails
checks.code: object Main { def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = throw new RuntimeException("intentional error") }

result.stderr:
Exception in thread "main" java.lang.RuntimeException: intentional error
	at Main$.main(Main.scala:1)
	at Main.main(Main.scala)

checks.name: Scala handled exception succeeds
checks.code: object Main { def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = try { throw new RuntimeException("expected") } catch { case _: RuntimeException => println("handled") } }

checks.name: Scala timeout
checks.code: object Main { def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = { while (true) {} } }

checks.name: Scala bounded output
checks.code: object Main { def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = { while (true) println("xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx") } }
